body:
Maintainer's decision (2026-09-19). Menu order on both clients: Overview, Join list, Settings, Server
admin (admins only), About, Log out — About last before Log out.

About, identical on both clients: the mark at the login size with "Tuppu" under it; one translated
sentence, "Tuppu is the Akkadian word for a clay tablet — the thing a list was pressed into."; a
"Version X" line; "MIT, © 2026 David R. Piegdon" small at the bottom.

Version: Android shows the app's own version (as Settings does today, from packageManager); the web
reads the server-injected <meta name="app-version"> (routes/webapp.py:54), which it never displayed
before. Same wording, and by construction the same meaning: one version number ships every part.

Android only, moved out of Settings: the whole Updates block — the "Check for updates automatically"
toggle and its help text, the status line (checking / up to date / available / failed), and the
check-on-open behaviour (T-149), which fires when About opens instead of Settings. The web has
nothing to update, so the block is absent there by design, like the Android-only delete confirmation.

Settings keeps account preferences only.

Strings: two new pairs in nine locales (About; the sentence); settings_version becomes an about_*
key and finally gets a web twin; the update strings move screens unchanged. One route per client.
title: An About screen in the main menu: the mark, what Tuppu means, the version, the licence — and Android's update check moves there from Settings
